mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (nickname, avatar_url, phone, email, password, is_bound, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{password}, #{isBound}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM user WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET password = #{password}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET partner_id = #{partnerId}, group_id = #{groupId}, is_bound = 1, relationship_start = CURDATE(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM album WHERE group_id = (SELECT group_id FROM user WHERE id = #{userId})
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) FROM photo WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND city IS NOT NULL AND city != '' AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) FROM photo WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND city IS NOT NULL AND city != '' AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0)

SELECT pr.provence AS name, COUNT(p.id) AS count, MAX(p.taken_date) AS takenDate FROM photo p JOIN provence pr ON p.province = pr.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.province IS NOT NULL AND (p.is_deleted IS NULL OR p.is_deleted = 0) GROUP BY pr.provence ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT pr.provence AS name, COUNT(p.id) AS count, MAX(p.taken_date) AS takenDate FROM photo p JOIN provence pr ON p.province = pr.id WHERE p.group_id = #{groupId} AND p.province IS NOT NULL AND (p.is_deleted IS NULL OR p.is_deleted = 0) GROUP BY pr.provence ORDER BY count DESC
